If a designer ever charged you for a 3D render of your place, you got robbed and I can prove it.

i built a free Claude skill that turns a single photo of a floor plan into a full 3D render you can walk through and Claude Fable 5.2 made this barbershop off one listing.

i https://t.co/535GCF7qEV https://t.co/jdgBVSNkMz

one character, two synchronized views: a gray wireframe with a detailed skeleton overlay, and a textured version with worn metal, an ivory head and a teal work jacket.

This is Moss Gorge, and I didn't touch Blender to make it.

I built it earlier with Astra in Codex, and it's probably my favorite environment so far: a hot-spring cinema in an autumn maple gorge, rendered in Cycles.

For complex USDZ environments I think Fable 5.2 is ahead right https://t.co/RqKyVccWRO

- Opus 5.5: fixed 4 flaws and integrated it into my main project https://t.co/lya2D9pPUp
